title: Private Tour: Ultimate North Shore Experience
blurb:
Choose between a peaceful walk through Waimea Valley, where you’ll stroll past lush botanical gardens and swim at a scenic waterfall, or paddle through the beauty of the Haleiwa River on a private guided kayaking and stand-up paddleboard tour. After your paddle, visit a local Hawaiian farm to learn about traditional farming practices and spot turtles in their natural habitat—all without the stress of planning; we’ve got everything covered.

- Up to 14 guests a booking
